periods.name: Prehistory & Early Human Settlement
periods.description: Archaeological evidence of microlithic stone tools, early agriculture, metallurgy, and early West African rainforest settlements.

periods.name: Precolonial Kingdoms & Indigenous Societies
periods.description: Formation of indigenous political systems, chiefdoms, trade networks, and ethnic community development including Limba, Temne, Mende, Sherbro, Kissi, Loko, and others.

periods.name: European Coastal Contact
periods.description: Portuguese exploration led by Pedro de Sintra, naming of Serra Leoa, early maritime trade, and ivory carving traditions.

periods.name: Atlantic Slave Trade & Bunce Island
periods.description: Expansion of transatlantic slave trading networks, European fortification (Bunce Island), slave raids, rice-cultivating captives sent to North America, and indigenous resistance.

periods.name: Abolition & Founding of Freetown
periods.description: Arrival of Black Poor, Nova Scotian Settlers, Jamaican Maroons, Sierra Leone Company administration, and establishment of Gran-ville Town and Freetown.

periods.name: Crown Colony & Liberated Africans
periods.description: Establishment of British Crown Colony, Vice-Admiralty Court, settlement of Liberated Africans (Recaptives), creation of Krio culture, founding of Fourah Bay College (1827).

periods.name: Protectorate Era & Colonial Expansion
periods.description: Declaration of the British Protectorate over the interior, indirect rule, 1898 Hut Tax War, railway construction, mining discovery, and early labor movements.

periods.name: Nationalist Movement & Independence
periods.description: Constitutional reforms, political party formation (SLPP, UPP), negotiations led by Sir Milton Margai, and full independence on 27 April 1961.

periods.name: First Republic & Political Transitions
periods.description: Early parliamentary democracy under Milton and Albert Margai, military coups of 1967–1968, Siaka Stevens era, APC one-party state, and Joseph Saidu Momoh's administration.

periods.name: Sierra Leone Civil War
periods.description: Invasion by RUF, NPRC military regime, 1996 democratic transition to Ahmad Tejan Kabbah, AFRC coup, CDF/Kamajors mobilizations, ECOMOG and British intervention, and Lomé Peace Agreement.

periods.name: Peacebuilding, TRC & Special Court
periods.description: Disarmament, Demobilization, Reintegration (DDR), Truth and Reconciliation Commission findings, Special Court for Sierra Leone trials, post-war institutional rebuilding, Ernest Bai Koroma presidency.

periods.name: Ebola Epidemic & Recovery
periods.description: Outbreak of Ebola Virus Disease, public health emergency, community healthcare initiatives, economic fallout, and international health collaboration.

periods.name: Contemporary Sierra Leone
periods.description: Democratic elections (2018, 2023 under President Julius Maada Bio), Free Quality School Education program, constitutional reform debates, economic development, and digital transformation.
